description: All current municipalities (gemeenten) of the Kingdom of the Netherlands as catalogued by openpotato/openholidaysapi.data (ODbL). Each gemeente carries its parent provincie reference (code + Dutch name) and multilingual names (NL/EN/DE). The total reflects the openpotato snapshot at commit a42b3974 (April 2026).
